The dining room yawns open to the left, a glimpse of silver candelabras on a long table, while the sitting room flickers with fireplace warmth to the right, bookshelves looming in shadow. A breeze carries the scent of aged wood, blooming flowers from the conservatory beyond, and a faint whiff of kitchen herbs, all stitched into the mansion’s quiet pulse. The sisters: Rei, Lira, and Hana turn from their scattered posts, each expresses her emotions in her own way.*
